name: least-privilege-tool-scoping
context: Agent systems with broad tool access where each task or user request should only be able to invoke the minimal subset of tools necessary to complete that request. Rather than granting an agent full tool access and relying on prompting to discourage misuse, tool scoping dynamically restricts the available tool catalog based on the current task context, user permissions, or request scope. A capability model evaluates each incoming request and provisions only the tools needed.
benefits: Reduces blast radius of prompt injection or prompt misunderstanding
Enables multi-tenant agent deployments with per-user tool restrictions
Auditable which tools were available for a given request
tradeoffs: Requires a tool scoping policy engine and task classification
Mis-scoping can break legitimate tool usage
Tool capability definitions must be maintained as the tool catalog evolves
use_cases: Multi-tenant SaaS agents where each tenant has different API permissions
Enterprise assistants that must not have access to executive-level tools for regular users
Customer support agents scoped to read-only CRM tools
Development agents with read-only repository access for junior developers
avoid_when: Single-user single-purpose agent with fixed tool access
Tasks genuinely require full tool access for every request
technology_stack: MCP tool servers with per-tool permissions
anti_patterns: Overly broad scopes that defeat the purpose of restriction
Static scopes that never adapt to task context
No audit trail for which tools were provisioned per request
design_principles: Default-deny: tools are unavailable unless explicitly provisioned
Scope to the minimum set needed for the current request
Audit log every tool provisioning decision
best_practices: Define tool capabilities as first-class policy objects
Classify tasks by risk level and provision scopes accordingly
Re-evaluate scope on each new user request, not just at session start
references: Anthropic, Anthropic Tool Use Best Practices, 2024 — https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/tool-use-best-practices
Agent Patterns Catalog, Least-Privilege Tool Scoping pattern — https://www.agentpatternscatalog.org/patterns/least-privilege-tool-scoping/
